# Copilot instructions

All project instructions live in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Read it first, and follow it.
It maps the docs in `docs/` and says which one to read before working in each area.

The two rules that always apply:

- Reply to the user in Ukrainian; code, comments and docs stay in English.
- Never tell the user to connect USB and the buck converter's Vo → ESP32 VIN at the same time.
